epics.title: Containerized Deployment Stack and Root Orchestration
epics.jtbd: When an operator or automated test runner deploys the CRIE assistant repository, I want a root-level docker-compose.yml configuration with an explicit health-check endpoint, so that the full application stack can be launched and verified reliably in runtime environments.
epics.sixSigmaMetric: Zero deployment startup failures across clean repository clones
epics.tocConstraintRef: Absence of root docker-compose specification preventing runtime verification
requirements: R1: Root-level docker-compose.yml file defining service build and port mapping for the FastAPI knowledge base assistant
R2: Service-level health check configuration querying /api/v1/health with defined interval, timeout, and retries

slices.title: Add Dockerfile and root docker-compose.yml with healthcheck probe
slices.jtbd: When implementing container orchestration for this epic, I want to define a root docker-compose.yml and container specification exposing /api/v1/health, so that runtime observation and startup verification succeed immediately.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a clean clone of the repository, When docker compose config or docker compose up is invoked, Then the service builds successfully and maps port 8097.
Given the containerized crie-assistant service running, When Docker evaluates service health against /api/v1/health, Then the health status transitions to healthy with HTTP 200 return code.
slices.tocConstraintRef: Root compose launch descriptor missing in repository
slices.sixSigmaMetric: 100% container boot and health probe pass rate

epics.title: Runtime Observation and Health Probe Verification
epics.jtbd: When an automated evaluator runs runtime health diagnostics on the repository, I want the launcher to locate docker-compose.yml and confirm the healthy state of the crie-assistant container, so that runtime validation produces verified evidence instead of missing-file errors.
epics.sixSigmaMetric: 100% pass rate on runtime observation health checks
epics.tocConstraintRef: Runtime launcher failure due to missing docker-compose.yml
requirements: R1: Resolution of docker-compose.yml not found error during repo root evaluation
R2: Automated verification verifying container startup and healthy API response code

slices.title: Validate runtime launcher execution and health endpoint contract
slices.jtbd: When verifying runtime observation for this epic, I want an automated test asserting that docker-compose.yml exists at the repository root and passes compose validation and health probe assertions, so that the launcher diagnostic failure is completely resolved.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given the repository root directory, When the launcher inspects the workspace, Then docker-compose.yml is found and valid.
Given the started container stack, When querying /api/v1/health, Then status equals healthy and all service capabilities are verified.
slices.tocConstraintRef: Launcher diagnostic failure on repo root inspection
